name: AppFlowy-GoTrue
description: Step 4/7: GoTrue authentication service for AppFlowy Cloud — handles user sign-up, login, JWT issuance, OAuth, email magic links, and SAML. Part of the AppFlowy Cloud stack.

variables.name: Base URL
variables.description: Public-facing GoTrue URL. Set to http://YOUR_SERVER_IP/gotrue (or your domain with /gotrue). Must be reachable by clients for OAuth redirects.

variables.name: Admin Email
variables.description: Email address of the initial admin account created on first start.

variables.name: Admin Password
variables.description: Password for the initial admin account.

variables.name: JWT Secret
variables.description: Shared JWT signing secret. MUST be identical to APPFLOWY_GOTRUE_JWT_SECRET in AppFlowy-Cloud. Minimum 32 characters. Keep private.

variables.name: Database URL
variables.description: GoTrue PostgreSQL connection string. Update user, password, and host if you changed them. Uses the auth schema.

variables.name: JWT Expiry (seconds)
variables.description: JWT token lifetime in seconds. Default: 604800 (7 days).

variables.name: Auto-confirm Email
variables.description: Set true to skip email confirmation (recommended for initial setup). Set false to require email confirmation — you must also configure SMTP.

variables.name: Disable Public Signup
variables.description: Set true to allow only invited users to sign up.

variables.name: Rate Limit (emails/min)
variables.description: Maximum emails GoTrue can send per minute.

variables.name: DB Driver
variables.description: Database driver — always postgres.

variables.name: Site URL
variables.description: Deep-link scheme for the AppFlowy native app.

variables.name: URI Allow List
variables.description: Allowed OAuth redirect URIs. ** permits all; restrict for production.

variables.name: JWT Admin Group
variables.description: JWT group name for admin users.

variables.name: Internal Port
variables.description: GoTrue internal listen port. Do not change.

variables.name: Mailer Confirm Path
variables.description: URL path for email confirmation links.

variables.name: Mailer Invite Path
variables.description: URL path for invite links.

variables.name: Mailer Recovery Path
variables.description: URL path for password recovery links.

variables.name: Mailer Email-Change Path
variables.description: URL path for email-change confirmation links.

variables.name: SMTP Host
variables.description: SMTP server hostname (e.g. smtp.gmail.com). Required if GOTRUE_MAILER_AUTOCONFIRM=false.

variables.name: SMTP Port
variables.description: SMTP port. Use 465 for TLS/SMTPS, 587 for STARTTLS.

variables.name: SMTP User
variables.description: SMTP sender email address.

variables.name: SMTP Password
variables.description: SMTP password.

variables.name: SMTP Admin Email
variables.description: Admin email used as the From address.

variables.name: SMTP Max Frequency
variables.description: Minimum interval between emails to the same address. Use 1ns for no limit.

variables.name: Magic Link Template URL
variables.description: Optional: public URL to a custom magic-link email HTML template.

variables.name: Google OAuth Enabled
variables.description: Enable Google OAuth login.

variables.name: Google Client ID
variables.description: Google OAuth client ID.

variables.name: Google Client Secret
variables.description: Google OAuth client secret.

variables.name: Google Redirect URI
variables.description: Google OAuth redirect URI.

variables.name: GitHub OAuth Enabled
variables.description: Enable GitHub OAuth login.

variables.name: GitHub Client ID
variables.description: GitHub OAuth app client ID.

variables.name: GitHub Client Secret
variables.description: GitHub OAuth app client secret.

variables.name: GitHub Redirect URI
variables.description: GitHub OAuth redirect URI.

variables.name: Discord OAuth Enabled
variables.description: Enable Discord OAuth login.

variables.name: Discord Client ID
variables.description: Discord OAuth application client ID.

variables.name: Discord Client Secret
variables.description: Discord OAuth application client secret.

variables.name: Discord Redirect URI
variables.description: Discord OAuth redirect URI.

variables.name: SAML Enabled
variables.description: Enable SAML 2.0 single sign-on.

variables.name: SAML Private Key
variables.description: PEM-encoded private key for SAML 2.0 signing.
